title: Pirate axe
description: This resource pack replaces the default Minecraft axes with detailed, pirate-themed choppers. Perfect for pirate roleplay, PvP, or anyone who wants to sail the seven seas in style.
body: This resource pack replaces the default Minecraft axes with detailed, pirate-themed choppers. Each axe features weathered wood, rusted or darkened metal, and rough, battle-worn edges that look perfect for boarding enemy ships or digging up buried treasure. Perfect for pirate roleplay, PvP, or anyone who wants to sail the seven seas in style.
